dedupe_keys.name: bcvtb building controls virtual test bed

description: The Building Controls Virtual Test Bed (BCVTB) is LBNL software for coupling simulation programs in co-simulation, and for coupling simulation programs with hardware; for example, a building can be simulated in EnergyPlus while its HVAC and controls are simulated in Modelica, exchanging data as they run. It is based on the Ptolemy II environment, whose graphical editor can also define control, device, communication, post-processing and real-time visualisation models. Linked programs include EnergyPlus, Dymola, Functional Mock-up Units for FMI 1.0 and 2.0, MATLAB and Simulink, Radiance, ESP-r, TRNSYS, a BACnet stack for building automation systems and a USB analog/digital interface. Typical uses are assessing integrated building energy and control systems, developing new control algorithms and verifying control logic before deployment to cut commissioning time. Coverage: generic. Access: free binaries for Windows, macOS and Linux, a manual, source code and a support mailing list; version 1.6.0 was released on 21 April 2016. Licence: the terms come with the distribution and were not read. Caveats: no release since 2016, and LBNL notes that configuring several linked programs needs expert users. Simulation uses: controls testing, hardware-in-the-loop experiments and co-simulated building digital twins. Related records: EnergyPlus, EnergyPlusToFMU, HELICS and the Modelica Buildings library.
